_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.5:5: Steinsaltz explains the asham of the shifchah charufah as brought for sexual intercourse with a betrothed maidservant.
hideSteinsaltz.8:1: Steinsaltz spells out bestiality (an animal that copulated with a person) and payment to a prostitute.
hideSteinsaltz.9:3: Steinsaltz spells out bestiality (an animal that copulated with a person) and payment to a prostitute.
hideSteinsaltz.14:2: Steinsaltz spells out bestiality (an animal that copulated with a person) and payment to a prostitute.
